s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of a painful, diffuse swelling in the cheek with a submucosal mass
salient_findings: Severe pain in the right cheek
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: 30-year-old woman
2-month history of swelling in the right cheek
Associated with severe pain
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
Mass is 2 cm × 2 cm, mobile, with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface
No colour change on the mucosal surface
Ultrasonography showed a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal mass with smooth mucosal surface and well-defined borders on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Ectopic lymph node
shortlist.why_kept: Provisional diagnosis based on clinical and radiographic findings

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Canalicular adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary, mobile submucosal mass in the cheek region

shortlist.label: Neurilemmoma
shortlist.why_kept: Painful, diffuse swelling in the cheek with a submucosal mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a mobile, submucosal mass with a smooth mucosal surface and no color change, along with ultrasonography showing a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion, is more consistent with a lipoma, which is a benign tumor composed of fat tissue.

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: Ectopic lymph nodes are typically not mobile and may not present as a distinct submucosal mass.

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles usually present with a fluctuant, bluish lesion due to the accumulation of mucin, which is not described in this case.

rejected.label: Canalicular adenoma
rejected.why: Canalicular adenomas are salivary gland tumors that are usually smaller and may not present with the described characteristics.

rejected.label: Neurilemmoma
rejected.why: Neurilemmomas are nerve sheath tumors that may not typically present as a submucosal mass in the cheek with the described features.
